title: createIntelligentAudit rejects audit creation when the framework is not licensed for the project
description: Licensing is checked independently of activation — a framework can be activated (ClientFramework exists) but not licensed for the current project's plan tier.
preconditions: A ComplianceFramework exists and is status='active'
isFrameworkLicensed(orgId, frameworkId, projectId) resolves to false for this org/project
steps: POST /api/intelligent-audits with a valid title, description, frameworkId, and projectId for the unlicensed framework
expectedResult: Response is 402 Payment Required with message 'Framework is not licensed for this project'; no IntelligentAudit document is created.

title: createIntelligentAudit rejects a licensed framework that has not been activated for this project
description: A framework can be org-licensed but never added as a ClientFramework for the specific project — Intelli Audit must not silently create an audit against an inactive project framework.
preconditions: Framework is licensed for the org/project
No ClientFramework document exists with status='active' for this project+framework
expectedResult: Response is 400 with message 'Framework must be activated for this project before starting Intelli Audit'.

title: createIntelligentAudit blocks creation while the project's compliance catalogue reconciliation is incomplete
description: reconcileFrameworkSeeding is called with autoFix, then re-checked; if actualRequirements/actualControls still fall short of expected after the fix attempt, audit creation must not proceed against a partial catalogue.
steps: Simulate a ClientFramework whose materialised client_requirements/client_controls are still being seeded (reconciliation reports actualRequirements < expectedRequirements after autoFix)
expectedResult: Response is 503 Service Unavailable with message 'The project compliance catalogue is still being prepared. Reconcile the framework and try again.'

title: createIntelligentAudit enforces the sessionsPerYear plan limit and blocks a new audit once exhausted
preconditions: Org's moduleConfig.intelliAudit.sessionsPerYear is set to a finite number (not -1)
Org already has that many non-archived IntelligentAudit documents created since Jan 1 of the current year
steps: POST /api/intelligent-audits to create one more audit for the same org
expectedResult: Response is 402 with errorCode 'IA_SESSIONS_EXHAUSTED' and a message naming the limit; no new audit document or credit debit occurs.

title: AI credits are debited on audit creation and refunded if the create() call fails after the debit
description: ledger.debit runs before IntelligentAudit.create(); if create() throws (e.g. a validation error), the controller must refund the same amount via ledger.refund with reason 'intelli_audit_create_failed' rather than leaving the org short-charged.
preconditions: Org has at least aiCreditsPerSession credits available
steps: Force IntelligentAudit.create() to throw (e.g. inject a duplicate _id collision) after the credits ledger has already been debited
Observe the org's AI credit balance before and after the failed request
expectedResult: The request fails with the underlying create error, but the credit ledger balance is restored to its pre-debit value via an automatic refund.

title: addControlToPhase2 rejects a requirementId that is not an active leaf requirement of the audit's own framework
description: Manually adding a control to the AI-suggested plan must validate the requirement against the audit's frameworkId, not just any framework's catalogue, and must reject non-leaf/inactive requirements.
steps: POST /api/intelligent-audits/:auditId/phase/2/controls with a requirementId that belongs to a different framework than audit.frameworkId
expectedResult: Response is 400 'requirementId is not an active leaf requirement in the audit framework'; recommendedControls is unchanged.

title: addControlToPhase2 rejects adding a control that already exists in the recommended list
preconditions: The audit's phase2.recommendedControls already contains an entry for requirementId X (as frameworkRequirementId or legacy uclRequirementId)
expectedResult: Response is 409 Conflict 'Control already exists in Phase 2'; no duplicate entry is pushed and totalControlsCount is unchanged.

title: completePhase2 is blocked while recommendationGeneration.status is not 'ready'
description: Guards against a user completing Phase 2 while the AI recommendation call to the Python IACR service is still pending or previously failed.
expectedResult: Response is 400 'Control recommendations are not ready. Retry generation before completing Phase 2.'; Phase 3 is not activated.

title: completePhase2 is blocked when every recommended control has been deselected
expectedResult: Response is 400 'Select at least one canonical framework requirement before completing Phase 2'.

title: runGapAnalysis returns 403 IA_GAP_ANALYSIS_LOCKED when the org's plan does not include gap analysis
preconditions: req.moduleConfig.intelliAudit.gapAnalysis is false (e.g. org is on the base plan)
Phase 3 is completed for the audit
expectedResult: Response is 403 with errorCode 'IA_GAP_ANALYSIS_LOCKED' and message referencing an upgrade to Scale or Enterprise; phaseStatus.phase4.gaps is left unchanged.

title: runGapAnalysis rejects execution before Phase 3 is completed
preconditions: gapAnalysis is enabled on the plan
steps: POST /api/intelligent-audits/:auditId/phase/4/analyze while Phase 3 evidence collection is still in progress
expectedResult: Response is 400 'Phase 3 must be completed first'; no gaps are generated.

title: runGapAnalysis flags a control with zero evidence attachments as a 'Missing Evidence' gap with riskScore contribution 3
preconditions: Phase 3 control has evidenceAttachments=[] and assessmentStatus != 'Not Started'
expectedResult: The returned gap for that control includes 'Missing Evidence' in gapTypes and the base riskScore reflects the +3 contribution before any other signal is added.
